description: Analyzes team health metrics (meeting load, focus time, distribution) from data already collected by other modules (doesn't call external APIs itself).

commands.name: analyze_team_health
commands.description: Given a list of members with their weekly meeting hours, returns aggregated team metrics.

commands.name: get_individual_metrics
commands.description: Returns detail for a person: pct of threshold used, trend relative to the previous week.

commands.name: generate_report
commands.description: Generates a Markdown report from already-calculated metrics.

commands.name: suggest_optimizations
commands.description: From the metrics, suggests concrete actions (doesn't execute them -- that's done by the workflow using this module).
